definitions: To alleviate or remove pain, distress, or an unpleasant feeling.
To release someone from a duty or responsibility, often by taking their place.
To make a situation less serious or more bearable.
To provide aid or assistance to someone in need.
To make something stand out by contrast.
examples: The medication will relieve the pain.
She was relieved of her duties.
A joke helped to relieve the tension.
They sent supplies to relieve the famine victims.
The dark background helps to relieve the bright colours.
